name: Scrollrus Image Scroller
author: samiur6688

sections.description:
Scrollrus Image Scroller is a lightweight Gutenberg block designed to display images with a smooth scrolling effect.

The block provides a simple way to present tall images, screenshots, and other visual content in a compact area while allowing visitors to view the image through a scrolling interaction.

Features:
– Gutenberg block
– Image scrolling effect
– Simple and focused interface
– Responsive design
– Lightweight implementation
– No external dependencies
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/scrollrus-image-scroller directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins screen in WordPress.
  3. Open a post or page and insert the Scrollrus Image Scroller block using the block editor.
sections.faq:
What type of images can I use?

You can use images supported by the WordPress Media Library, including screenshots, website previews, and other tall images.

Is this a gallery block?

No. Scrollrus Image Scroller is designed to display and scroll an individual image rather than provide a multi-image gallery.

Does the plugin require any external services?

No. The plugin does not require any external services.
